scope: Frozen synthetic D geometry only; no full source/time integral, no device-scale run, no physical certification.

geometry.projection: For every vertex, 0 < dv < dX. A positive-denominator projective map sends a convex box to the convex hull of the images of its vertices; independently checked against robust_mask_v02 on sampled rays.

duration_event_independent_check.event_root_method: independent corner projection, monotone-chain hull, point-to-edge distance, bisection
duration_event_independent_check.duration_scope_note: The vapor full-cover interval is independently recomputed. An independent open ion-source patch stays clear of the ion plate for every target position; cross-source separation is also established, so ion flux is positive throughout. This establishes the duration decomposition for this frozen geometry, not float-certified endpoint bounds.

ion_own_plate_open_clear_source_patch.conclusion: strict x separation for an interior source point and therefore an open positive-area source neighborhood for all target positions; beam-emission and target-incidence cosines are positive

cover_slack_lipschitz.argument: Corresponding projected box vertices move no faster than these bounds; their convex hull Hausdorff speed is no larger. Signed distance of the origin to a convex polygon is 1-Lipschitz under Hausdorff motion, hence cover_slack inherits the same bound.

float_guard: The 1e-11 m guard in support_intervals is not an outward-rounded or otherwise validated floating-point error bound. Numerical results remain conditional; no strict enclosure claim.
